definitions.explanation: A small document used to record business transactions, orders, deliveries, or accounting entries. Common in retail, restaurants, and accounting.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}{伝票|でんぴょう}を{発行|はっこう}する。
レジで{伝票|でんぴょう}をもらってください。
examples.english: Please get the slip at the register.

examples.japanese: {伝票|でんぴょう}を{整理|せいり}して{帳簿|ちょうぼ}に{記入|きにゅう}する。
examples.english: Organize the slips and enter them in the ledger.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{伝|でん} (transmit) + {票|ひょう} (slip, vote)

TYPES OF {伝票|でんぴょう}:
- {売上|うりあげ}{伝票|でんぴょう} - sales slip
- {仕入|しい}れ{伝票|でんぴょう} - purchase slip
- {入金|にゅうきん}{伝票|でんぴょう} - receipt voucher
- {出金|しゅっきん}{伝票|でんぴょう} - payment voucher
- {振替|ふりかえ}{伝票|でんぴょう} - transfer slip
- {納品|のうひん}{伝票|でんぴょう} - delivery slip

RESTAURANT CONTEXT:
In restaurants, {伝票|でんぴょう} (also called "お{会計|かいけい}」) is the bill/check that the customer receives.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {伝票|でんぴょう}を{切|き}る - to write up a slip
- {伝票|でんぴょう}を{回|まわ}す - to pass along a slip
- {伝票|でんぴょう}{処理|しょり} - slip processing

ACCOUNTING USE:
In bookkeeping, {伝票|でんぴょう} serves as the source document for recording transactions in the {帳簿|ちょうぼ} (ledger).
